nodes.guardrail: Before deepening ground army and economy, verify opponent has not transitioned to air or committed to heavy pressure. If air units or a large attack are detected, prioritize building anti-air and defensive structures.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.

nodes.guardrail: Before continuing ground strength, verify opponent has not teched up or shown air presence. If they have, prioritize teching to counter and adding anti-air.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent techs up or shows air presence.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing economy and production, verify you have sufficient army size to defend against potential pressure. If army is too small, prioritize building units before expanding further.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent pressures or techs up.

nodes.guardrail: Before maintaining ground strength, verify opponent has not teched to air or shown heavy pressure. If they have, prioritize adding anti-air and defensive structures.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent techs to air or shows heavy pressure.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing defense, verify opponent is actually pressuring rather than expanding. If they are expanding, prioritize matching their economy and expanding yourself.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent expands instead of pressuring.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing economy and production, verify opponent has not started a pressure or teched up. If they have, prioritize building units and defensive structures.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent pressures or techs up.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing defense, verify opponent's commitment to air or ground. If they commit to air, prioritize anti-air; if ground, prioritize ground defense.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent commits to air or ground.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing defense, verify opponent's commitment to air or ground. If they commit to air, prioritize anti-air; if ground, prioritize ground defense.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent commits to air or ground.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing air, verify opponent has not teched anti-air or shown heavy ground pressure. If they have, prioritize ground defense and consider transitioning back to ground.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent techs anti-air or shows heavy ground pressure.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing air, verify opponent has not teched anti-air or shown heavy ground pressure. If they have, prioritize ground defense and consider transitioning back to ground.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent techs anti-air or shows heavy ground pressure.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing economy and production, verify opponent has not started a pressure or teched up. If they have, prioritize building units and defensive structures.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent pressures or techs up.

nodes.guardrail: Before increasing defense, verify opponent is actually pressuring rather than expanding. If they are expanding, prioritize matching their economy and expanding yourself.
nodes.recheck_condition: Recheck if opponent expands instead of pressuring.
